provenance.origin: Repository-original deterministic synthetic weights and inputs.

generator.generation_order: Separate streams for W1, W2 and dense X; each logical matrix is filled row-major.
generator.signed_basis: X[r,k] = (2 if r is even else -2) if k == r else 0

model.packed_element_order: Earlier memory element occupies the low 16 bits of each uint32 word.
model.reference_scope: Independent integer source references only; native execution and dispatch evidence remain unearned.
